title: Efficient cause God; vocation immediate and mediate
pass_a_gloss: Pass A clause gloss (reordered): Immediate or extraordinary calling stands as when God sends some by His peculiar mandate without human election (patriarchs, prophets, Apostles). Mediate and ordinary calling runs through means God constituted, directed by Him as principal cause. — Its chief efficient cause stands as God, and ye Holy Spirit Himself speaks through ye prophets. Ye proximate cause stands as divine calling—also named mission or election—either immediate or mediate.
pass_b_english: Its chief efficient cause is God, and the Holy Spirit Himself speaks through the prophets. The proximate cause is divine calling—also named mission or election—either immediate or mediate.

Immediate or extraordinary calling is when God sends some by His peculiar mandate without human election (patriarchs, prophets, Apostles). Mediate and ordinary calling runs through means God constituted, directed by Him as principal cause.
source_text: Eius causa princeps efficiens est Deus (Ps. 68:12; 1 Cor. 12:28; Matt. 9:38), et Spiritus Sanctus ipse loquitur per prophetas. Proxima causa est vocatio divina (Heb. 5:4), alias missio (Rom. 10:14), electio (Luke 6:13). Estque alia immediata, alia mediata. Immediata seu extraordinaria est, cum Deus quosdam peculiari mandato instructos non accedente hominum electione mittit—in V.T. patriarchas et prophetas, in N.T. Apostolos. Mediata et ordinaria est, quae fit per media divinitus constituta, per quae a Deo ut causa principe dirigitur (Num. 3:11; 2 Chron. 29:11; Eph. 4:11; Acts 20:28).
